title: No Pain, No Gain
intro: The safe road is long and your stamina is short. Spikes cost [b]25 HP[/b] each, and a repair kit gives back [b]30[/b]. Sometimes you pay in health.
cs_note: Most problems trade one resource for another: time vs. memory in real programs, stamina vs. HP here. Before you run, add up what each plan costs.
hints: Count the stamina the top route needs: every move and every turn costs 1.
